releases.title: Multi-board flashing station
control_changes: Added a Flashing page that automatically detects and provisions up to ten USB-connected FireBeetles in parallel.
Added stable USB hub slots, live progress, retry controls, persistent history, and disconnect/replug protection for batch assembly.
Added guarded factory sessions that assign permanent numeric performer IDs through the connected conductor and display them for physical labeling.
Added hardened Raspberry Pi and macOS station services plus a checksum-pinned production serial-flash bundle.
firmware_changes: Added a conductor serial command that reserves performer IDs and acknowledges them only after the updated MAC-to-ID table is durably saved.
Added rollback behavior so a failed conductor save cannot expose an ID assignment that will disappear after restart.
Kept the field radio protocol at v10, so v0.6.0 performers remain radio-compatible while newly provisioned boards receive v0.7.0.

releases.title: Independent lantern groups
control_changes: Added eight independently controlled lantern groups with separate patterns and brightness.
Added persistent group names and fast group assignment from the node list, including for lanterns that have not been positioned.
Added per-lantern 16, 32, or 64 LED hardware profiles.
Made field blackout reversible while preserving each group's prior brightness.
firmware_changes: Added protocol-v10 group membership, eight per-group pattern configurations, and 16/32/64 LED-count profiles.
Added persistent blackout recovery so all group brightness levels can be restored after an all-field blackout.
Removed the retired USB battery keepalive experiment while preserving the protocol-v10 beacon layout.
Protocol v10 requires the conductor and all protocol-v8 performers to be flashed together from this release.

releases.title: Reliable Pi release activation
control_changes: Fixed first-time Pi release activation by making commit-specific Python environments accessible to the unprivileged control service.
Repaired the permissions of an already-built release environment before safely reusing it.
firmware_changes: Rebuilt the protocol-v8 permanent-ID firmware from the reviewed hotfix commit; runtime performer behavior is unchanged from v0.5.0.
Protocol v8 still requires the conductor and all protocol-v7 performers to be flashed together.

releases.title: Permanent performer IDs
control_changes: Added stable numeric performer IDs in the control UI, including while boards are offline.
Separated permanent board identity from deployment position so replacement boards keep their own physical labels.
Added explicit duplicate-ID conflict visibility and safer performer inventory management.
firmware_changes: Added conductor-authoritative MAC-to-ID inventory with recovery after performer NVS is erased.
Added protocol-v8 inventory rows carrying permanent IDs and optional positions.
Updated the factory-watcher tooling to assign FireBeetle IDs, verify readback, and print physical-label banners after its one-time install --factory refresh.
Migrated existing protocol-v7 position tables without losing deployment coordinates.
Protocol v8 requires the conductor and all performers to be flashed together from this release.

releases.title: Safe pull-based field releases
control_changes: Added pull-based GitOps deployment from an explicitly promoted production release.
Added exact-version service health checks and automatic rollback when a Pi deployment fails.
Made Pi deployment defer safely while a field firmware OTA is active.
Added separate web-control and field-firmware deployment status in the Operations UI.
Added a user-visible release history with distinct control-plane and firmware changes.
firmware_changes: Added immutable, checksum-verified firmware artifacts to each software release.
Added production-release USB provisioning bundles and automatic FireBeetle flashing for batch assembly.
Added automatic staging of the promoted firmware on the Pi for an operator-authorized OTA.
Kept field firmware rollout separate from Pi deployment so offline performers remain safely deferred.

releases.title: Remote field operations and richer light patterns
control_changes: Added authenticated remote administration through the Raspberry Pi control plane.
Added persistent pattern review, preview, saving, and live broadcast workflows.
Added guarded firmware OTA with progress, recovery state, and partial-online cohorts.
Added field power scheduling, battery monitoring, Wi-Fi operations, and calibration tools.
firmware_changes: Added Firefly, Ocean Wave, and ring-addressable Fire Flicker patterns.
Added firmware identity reporting and field-wide OTA over ESP-NOW.
Changed OTA targeting to freeze online performers while deferring offline layout rows.
Added runtime power policy, dusk sensing, light sleep, and power telemetry support.
